channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Greg Oden | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Greg Oden from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David West on Greg Oden
item.description:
David West:

“Greg Oden. The one year that dude was healthy, we played them like three times in the first month-and-a-half of the season or something. I remember bumping up against him and being like, 'Yo, this dude is going to be a beast.' We couldn't do anything with him -- me and Tyson [Chandler] together -- he was just dunking everything around the basket. He was 285-to-290 [pounds], but not like a bulky fat. If Greg Oden had stayed around, I don't think small-ball evolves. If he's healthy, I don't think small-ball evolves the way it did. No way.”

David West on Greg Oden, Oct 14, 2020. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Greg Oden
item.description:
“The best I ever was around – one of the best. Go back to his junior year, we’re playing Ohio State and I put Noah on Greg Oden. And he’s out there guarding guards. We played Brad’s team, I think Brad was an assistant, we played Butler to go to the Elite 8. [They’re] playing with four guards and I’ve got him guarding a guard.”

Billy Donovan on Greg Oden, Mar 20, 2018. Source: Celtics Wire.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Greg Oden
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Wade on Oden:

“He doesn't talk much, so it's hard to figure out what he likes. We've got to kind of figure it out on the court.”

Dwyane Wade on Greg Oden, Mar 22, 2014. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Greg Oden
item.description:
Joseph Goodman:Spoelstra on Oden:

“He's day to day. We’re learning how to manage a lot of guys like that, but he really has to be treated like that.”

Erik Spoelstra on Greg Oden, Jan 16, 2014. Source: Twitter @JoeGoodmanJr.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Greg Oden
item.description:
“They needed to look at rebuilding before that thing crumbled. And they needed to look at everything, including the head coaching position. With some guys, I knew it wasn’t part of their plan to be there. We had two of our core players — Brandon (Roy) and Greg (Oden) — basically retire. So I told him that he needed to get something for the guys we had, he needed to look at redoing this whole thing before it crumbles.”

Nate McMillan on Brandon Roy, Greg Oden, Nov 30, 2013. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Greg Oden
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Spoelstra on Oden:

“He's certainly getting stronger in his legs. He hasn't lifted like this in his life.”

Erik Spoelstra on Greg Oden, Nov 22, 2013. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Greg Oden
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Spoelstra on Oden:

“He's making progress. We're going to stick with the plan. We're not going to suit him up... but he knows.”

Erik Spoelstra on Greg Oden, Nov 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Greg Oden
item.description:
Jrue Holday and Ryan Anderson have heard about the New Orleans Pelicans as one of the teams considering the signing of Greg Oden, and both endorse the possibility.

“Signing [Oden] would be awesome, a great addition to what we want to do,”

Jrue Holiday on Greg Oden, Jul 26, 2013. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Ryan Anderson on Greg Oden
item.description:
“A healthy Greg Oden is a great player, so I’d definitely be excited to play alongside him,”

Ryan Anderson on Greg Oden, Jul 26, 2013. Source: RealGM.

item.title: Pat Riley on Greg Oden
item.description:
“We will track, I think, Greg Oden. From my understanding is that he's working out, he's working out on the court and that he wants to be ready to play in training camp. But this isn't the time to have that conversation with him. We do have interest in him and we will track him.”

Pat Riley on Greg Oden, Jul 15, 2013. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Greg Oden
item.description:
Justin Verrier:Aldridge on Oden:

“I just sent him a text saying keep you head up, keep working hard, things will work out.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Greg Oden, Feb 21, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chad Buchanan on Greg Oden
item.description:
Blazers Acting GMChad Buchanan on Greg Oden's left knee procedure:

“Still up in the air on the date.. It's a day-by-day update we get from the doctors there [in Vail] on when they are ready to do it.”

Chad Buchanan on Greg Oden, Feb 14, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Greg Oden
item.description:
John Canzano:Wesley Matthews on Oden:

“I haven't seen Greg, but I keep hearing that he's looking good. I'm excited about that.”

Wesley Matthews on Greg Oden, Nov 29, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Greg Oden
item.description:
Former Blazer General Manager Kevin Pritchard joined 95.5 the Game with John Canzano and talked about a wide range of subjects including some hindsight on the Blazers' decision to draft Greg Oden with the top overall pick in the 2007 NBA Draft over Kevin Durant.

“I have never studied a person or players like I did Durant/Oden,”

Kevin Pritchard on Greg Oden, Jul 7, 2011. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: John Salley on Greg Oden
item.description:

“If I was able to get Greg Oden down here and put him through some tests at the wellness center I work with, you could tell what was really going on with him,”

John Salley on Greg Oden, Mar 1, 2011. Source: Beyond The Beat.

item.title: Steve Patterson on Greg Oden
item.description:
While in high school, he also had ligament damage to his right wrist, which was later operated on at Ohio State University.

“I did have concerns with a guy who was hurt as much as Oden,”

Steve Patterson on Greg Oden, Jan 1, 2011. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Marcus Camby on Greg Oden
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Marcus Camby on Greg Oden:

“I haven't really seen him all summer, he hasn't really been around the team since I've been around the team.”

Marcus Camby on Greg Oden, Sep 19, 2010. Source: Twitter.
